summary: American Fusion, Inc., a Texas electric-services registrant, filed an 8-K reporting September 30, 2026 Exchange Agreements with twelve officers, directors, consultants and advisors holding contractual stock-compensation rights. Each $240,000 Existing Compensation Right was exchanged for up to 24,000 shares of newly designated Series C Convertible Preferred Stock, aggregating up to 288,000 preferred shares for $2,880,000 of accrued obligations. No cash changed hands; the preferred was sole consideration, with mutual releases and Rule 506/4(a)(2) exemption claimed. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share or premium was disclosed; holders are accredited investors. Watch conversion terms, dilution and preferred overhang.
